==Description==
'''Ballerina Spin''' is an emote that could have been obtained at Level 24 of the regular [[The Final Act Event#The Final Act Battle Pass|The Final Act Battle Pass]] track. It was made by STEALTH_NOVA. The emote is looped and music can be heard while performing the emote. The player is unable to interact with it, but they can move while performing it.

Upon use, music begins playing as the player performs a ballerina spin. This will loop forever until the player unequips the emote, which will play an outro animation.

It had a cost of {{PlushieSnowman|775}} or {{Robux|108}} ({{Robux|86}} during the Christmas 2025 Sale), with a total cost of {{PlushieSnowman|8,575}} or {{Robux|2,115}} ({{Robux|1,682}} during the Christmas 2025 Sale).
